summary: Retain CSSOM semantics for style.setProperty because parsing, custom properties, priority, and serialization are observable.

semantics.property_names: CSS property normalization; custom properties remain case-sensitive
semantics.priority: empty or important semantics; invalid priority handling must match CSSOM

caveats: Do not map arbitrary CSS property names directly to C# object properties.

tests.name: sets property and priority
tests.expected_behavior: prints serialized red value and important priority

tests.name: custom property preserves custom name/value semantics
tests.expected_behavior: CSSOM custom-property value is preserved/serialized per CSSOM, not treated as a normal C# property
